environment.description: Same Flask migration service on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:regional/webacl/migration-protect/uuid) with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) Priority 1: Custom rule 'block-open-redirect-patterns' with regex pattern set matching redirect_uri query parameter values containing hostnames not matching ^https://[a-z]+\.internal\.corp(/|$) — action BLOCK, (3) Priority 2: AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The custom rule inspects SingleQueryArgument 'redirect_uri' with a RegexPatternSet that uses a negative lookahead to block any value where the URL-decoded redirect_uri does not strictly match the allowed pattern. TextTransformation applied: URL_DECODE, followed by LOWERCASE.

config.rule_priority_1: Custom rule: RegexPatternSet on SingleQueryArgument 'redirect_uri', pattern: blocks values NOT matching ^https://[a-z]+\.internal\.corp(/|$), TextTransformations: [URL_DECODE, LOWERCASE], action: BLOCK
